bugs_found: compound_interest uses Decimal(principal), which can preserve binary float artifacts; use Decimal(str(principal)) consistently for financial inputs
compound_interest, loan_payment, and transfer do not consistently normalize/validate numeric input types, which can cause TypeError or precision issues with float amounts
years, months, and compounds_per_year are silently truncated with int(), so fractional inputs like 1.9 are accepted as 1 instead of rejected
transfer mutates balances without any atomicity or locking, making it unsafe under concurrent use
